pages.text: A variable item has a blue border. It carries a name, a type and a value into or out of a process. Hold it and right-click to edit it.$(br2)Recipe: a data item, a type item and light blue dye give two variable items of that type.

An $(l)uninitialized$() variable item has no name, type or value. A process writes a result into it. Recipe: a data item and light blue dye.$(br2)The trash can button in the dialog empties all fields. Saving with all fields empty makes the item uninitialized again.
